answer: Give established reviewers a fixed, nontransferable endorsement budget. In an ocean-data market, agents walnut and ivory can create aliases, but new identities receive weight only from capacity-conserving flow from audited roots; internal endorsements cannot create capacity. Increase a root's budget only after independently checked jobs. A farm must earn scarce outside endorsements or compromise roots, rather than manufacture votes by registering keys. Root capture remains a stated trust assumption.
